# `ingress.interval_s` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `300` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | ingress |
| Unit | s |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `ingress.interval_s` only if you observe problems with the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[ingress]
interval_s = 300
```

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

| Type | integer |

# PQ-E3246 SCHEDULER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The internal work queue of the scheduler is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `scheduler.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 1.1

# PaderQueue 2.3 release notes

Released on 2023-03-27.

## New features

- New option `scheduler.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time, in bytes.
- New error code PQ-E4540 (METRICS_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `auth.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the authentication module that validates client tokens starts throttling.
- New option `partitioner.log_level`: log verbosity of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.
- New option `quota.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New error code PQ-E4157 (REPLICATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `dlq.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue before an operation is reported as failed.

- New error code PQ-E2771 (DLQ_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1736 (BROKER_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `dlq.batch_size`: number of messages the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue processes together in one batch.
- New option `auth.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the authentication module that validates client tokens before an operation is reported as failed.
- New option `partitioner.batch_size`: number of messages the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written processes

# `dlq.max_retries` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of retry attempts of the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `8` |
| Available since | 2.3 |
| Component | dlq |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `dlq.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[dlq]
max_retries = 8
```

Title: PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL
Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

Title: Postmortem INC-2024-186
Type: incident
Version: 4.x

# Postmortem INC-2024-186: inventory-sync degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 40 minutes
**Impact:** Delayed messages for `inventory-sync`

## Summary
During the incident, `inventory-sync` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E2617 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `inventory-sync` fired.
- T+10: On-call engineer found PQ-E2617 in the broker logs.
- T+20: The team paused the noisiest producer.
- T+40: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E2617.
- Add an alert for this error code.

Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E3891 COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `compactor: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the compactor is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `compactor.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# `scheduler.log_level` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Log verbosity of the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: debug | info | warn | error |
| Default | `error` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | scheduler |

## Notes

Changes to `scheduler.log_level` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[scheduler]
log_level = "error"
```

# PaderQueue 1.0 release notes

Released on 2021-03-02.

## New features

- New error code PQ-E2470 (SNAPSHOTTER_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `retention.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New option `replicator.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes, in bytes.
- New option `metrics.batch_size`: number of messages the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics processes together in one batch.
- New error code PQ-E4934 (SPOOL_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4964 (DLQ_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New option `acktracker.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, in bytes.
- New error code PQ-E2622 (QUOTA_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New option `metrics.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New error code PQ-E3221 (BROKER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `broker.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues.
- New error code PQ-E4582 (RETENTION_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `retention.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New error code PQ-E1019 (INGRESS_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2617 (DLQ_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `scheduler.queue_capacity`:

# PaderQueue 2.3 release notes

Released on 2023-03-27.

## New features

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**First introduced in:** 3.0

The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

- A deployment where nodes have different settings

Title: retention.queue_capacity
Type: config
Version: 4.x

# `retention.queue_capacity`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `10000` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | retention |
| Unit | tasks |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `retention.queue_capacity` only if you observe problems with the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[retention]
queue_capacity = 10000
```

Title: Postmortem INC-2024-186
Type: incident

# Postmortem INC-2024-186: inventory-sync degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 40 minutes
**Impact:** Delayed messages for `inventory-sync`

## Summary
During the incident, `inventory-sync` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E2617 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `inventory-sync` fired.
- T+10: On-call engineer found PQ-E2617 in the broker logs.
- T+20: The team paused the noisiest producer.
- T+40: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E2617.
- Add an alert for this error code.

# PaderQueue 1.2 release notes

Released on 2021-12-06.

## New features

- New option `retention.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New error code PQ-E2137 (DLQ_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2273 (COORDINATOR_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `auth.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the authentication module that validates client tokens.
- New error code PQ-E3859 (BROKER_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4020 (SPOOL_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.
- New error code PQ-E4013 (AUTH_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3792 (AUTH_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1565 (COORDINATOR_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `compactor.log_level`: log verbosity of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.
- New option `quota.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.
- New option `quota.enabled`: turns the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant on or off.
- New option `spool.batch_size`: number of messages the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments processes together in one batch.
- New option `partitioner.compression`: compression codec that the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written uses for stored

Size of the in-memory buffer used by the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written, in bytes.

|---|---|

| Unit | bytes |

Changes to `partitioner.buffer_bytes` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

```toml
[partitioner]
buffer_bytes = 1048576
```

# Postmortem INC-2024-128: shipping-tracker degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 12 minutes
**Impact:** Delayed messages for `shipping-tracker`

## Summary
During the incident, `shipping-tracker` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E2622 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `shipping-tracker` fired.
- T+3: On-call engineer found PQ-E2622 in the broker logs.
- T+6: The team temporarily moved traffic to the secondary cluster.
- T+12: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E2622.
- Add an alert for this error code.

# `dlq.timeout_ms` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Time in milliseconds that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue waits for a response before the operation fails.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `30000` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | dlq |
| Unit | ms |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `dlq.timeout_ms` only if you observe problems with the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[dlq]
timeout_ms = 30000
```

# PQ-E2771 DLQ_OPERATION_TIMEOUT

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `dlq: operation timeout`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
An operation of the dlq did not complete within the configured timeout.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check network latency and load on the involved nodes. For slow but healthy clusters, increase `dlq.timeout_ms`.

# PaderQueue 3.1 release notes

Released on 2024-01-15.

## New features

- New option `acktracker.batch_size`: number of messages the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed processes together in one batch.
- New error code PQ-E1176 (INGRESS_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.

# PaderQueue 2.0 release notes

Released on 2022-04-11.

This is a major release. Read the section on changed defaults before upgrading.

## New features

- New option `compactor.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.
- New option `partitioner.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written, in bytes.
- New error code PQ-E2051 (COMPACTOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New option `acktracker.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.
- New option `spool.compression`: compression codec that the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments uses for stored or transferred data.
- New error code PQ-E3575 (COORDINATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4426 (SCHEDULER_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4708 (SCHEDULER_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `coordinator.compression`: compression codec that the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers uses for stored or transferred data.
- New option `dlq.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue.
- New option `snapshotter.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.
- New error code PQ-E3321 (REPLICATOR_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `retention.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the retention

# `partitioner.queue_capacity` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.

Title: PaderQueue 3.0 release notes
Type: changelog
Version: 3.0

- **Changed default:** `metrics.interval_s` now defaults to `10` (previously `300`).
- **Changed default:** `scheduler.log_level` now defaults to `info` (previously `error`).

## New features

- New option `retention.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New option `ingress.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST starts throttling.
- New error code PQ-E1441 (COORDINATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4572 (QUOTA_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `broker.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues, in bytes.
- New option `metrics.log_level`: log verbosity of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New option `acktracker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.
- New option `quota.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.
- New error code PQ-E4007 (BROKER_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2154 (QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3891 (COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New error code PQ-E2758 (RETENTION_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2995 (QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1563

Title: PaderQueue 3.0 release notes
Type: changelog
Version: 3.0

- **Changed default:** `metrics.interval_s` now defaults to `10` (previously `300`).
- **Changed default:** `scheduler.log_level` now defaults to `info` (previously `error`).

## New features

- New option `retention.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New option `ingress.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST starts throttling.
- New error code PQ-E1441 (COORDINATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4572 (QUOTA_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `broker.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues, in bytes.
- New option `metrics.log_level`: log verbosity of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New option `acktracker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.
- New option `quota.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.
- New error code PQ-E4007 (BROKER_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2154 (QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3891 (COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New error code PQ-E2758 (RETENTION_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2995 (QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1563

# `compactor.log_level` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Log verbosity of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: debug | info | warn | error |
| Default | `info` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | compactor |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `compactor.log_level` only if you observe problems with the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[compactor]
log_level = "info"
```

# PQ-E3805 DLQ_COMPONENT_DISABLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `dlq: component disabled`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 1.1

## What it means
A request needed the dlq, but the dlq is switched off.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Enable the component by setting `dlq.enabled` to `true` and restart the node.

# PQ-E3891 COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `compactor: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the compactor is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `compactor.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

Title: acktracker.queue_capacity
Type: config
Version: 4.x

# `acktracker.queue_capacity`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `5000` |
| Available since | 2.2 |
| Component | acktracker |
| Unit | tasks |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `acktracker.queue_capacity` only if you observe problems with the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
queue_capacity = 5000
```

# PQ-E4426 SCHEDULER_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The scheduler gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `scheduler.max_retries`.

# PQ-E1944 RETENTION_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `retention: work queue full`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 2.2

## What it means
The internal work queue of the retention is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `retention.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# Postmortem INC-2025-134: inventory-sync degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 25 minutes
**Impact:** Duplicate processing in `inventory-sync`

## Summary
During the incident, `inventory-sync` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4426 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `inventory-sync` fired.
- T+6: On-call engineer found PQ-E4426 in the broker logs.
- T+12: The team paused the noisiest producer.
- T+25: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4426.
- Add an alert for this error code.

Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E4157 REPLICATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the replicator is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `replicator.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

Title: PQ-E3891 COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL
Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E3891 COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `compactor: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the compactor is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `compactor.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# `compactor.compression` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Compression codec that the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages uses for stored or transferred data.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: none | lz4 | zstd |
| Default | `none` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | compactor |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `compactor.compression` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[compactor]
compression = "none"
```

Title: Postmortem INC-2025-134
Type: incident

# Postmortem INC-2025-134: inventory-sync degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 25 minutes
**Impact:** Duplicate processing in `inventory-sync`

## Summary
During the incident, `inventory-sync` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4426 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `inventory-sync` fired.
- T+6: On-call engineer found PQ-E4426 in the broker logs.
- T+12: The team paused the noisiest producer.
- T+25: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4426.
- Add an alert for this error code.

Title: auth.worker_threads (PaderQueue 3.x)
Type: config
Version: 3.x

# `auth.worker_threads` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Number of worker threads used by the authentication module that validates client tokens.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `2` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | auth |
| Unit | threads |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `auth.worker_threads` only if you observe problems with the authentication module that validates client tokens, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[auth]
worker_threads = 2
```

# PQ-E4572 QUOTA_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the quota is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `quota.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

Title: PaderQueue 3.0 release notes

Version: 3.0

- **Changed default:** `metrics.interval_s` now defaults to `10` (previously `300`).
- **Changed default:** `scheduler.log_level` now defaults to `info` (previously `error`).

## New features

- New option `retention.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New option `ingress.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST starts throttling.
- New error code PQ-E1441 (COORDINATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4572 (QUOTA_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `broker.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues, in bytes.
- New option `metrics.log_level`: log verbosity of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New option `acktracker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.
- New option `quota.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.
- New error code PQ-E4007 (BROKER_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2154 (QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3891 (COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New error code PQ-E2758 (RETENTION_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2995 (QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1563

Changes to `snapshotter.threshold_percent` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

[snapshotter]

Document: d0406
Title: PaderQueue 3.0 release notes
Type: changelog
Version: 3.0

- **Changed default:** `metrics.interval_s` now defaults to `10` (previously `300`).
- **Changed default:** `scheduler.log_level` now defaults to `info` (previously `error`).

## New features

- New option `retention.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New option `ingress.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST starts throttling.
- New error code PQ-E1441 (COORDINATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4572 (QUOTA_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `broker.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues, in bytes.
- New option `metrics.log_level`: log verbosity of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New option `acktracker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.
- New option `quota.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.
- New error code PQ-E4007 (BROKER_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2154 (QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3891 (COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New error code PQ-E2758 (RETENTION_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2995 (QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1563

# `dlq.timeout_ms` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Time in milliseconds that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue waits for a response before the operation fails.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `30000` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | dlq |
| Unit | ms |

The default works for most deployments. Change `dlq.timeout_ms` only if you observe problems with the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[dlq]
timeout_ms = 30000
```

# PQ-E4663 COORDINATOR_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `coordinator: throttled`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 1.1

## What it means
The coordinator is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `coordinator.threshold_percent`.

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `95` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | retention |
| Unit | % |
| Default changed | in 3.0 (see release notes) |

## Notes

Changes to `retention.threshold_percent` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[retention]
threshold_percent = 95
```

# PQ-E3891 COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `compactor: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the compactor is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `compactor.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# PQ-E1451 INGRESS_CODEC_MISMATCH

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `ingress: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
Two nodes of the ingress use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

## Common causes
- A slow disk
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Set `ingress.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

Type: config
Version: 4.x

# `partitioner.max_retries`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `3` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | partitioner |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `partitioner.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
max_retries = 3
```

Title: dlq.timeout_ms (PaderQueue 3.x)
Type: config
Version: 3.x

# `dlq.timeout_ms` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Time in milliseconds that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue waits for a response before the operation fails.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `30000` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | dlq |
| Unit | ms |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `dlq.timeout_ms` only if you observe problems with the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[dlq]
timeout_ms = 30000
```

Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E3108 SPOOL_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `spool: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.1

## What it means
The spool refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `spool.max_connections`.

Title: Postmortem INC-2024-186
Type: incident

# Postmortem INC-2024-186: inventory-sync degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 40 minutes
**Impact:** Delayed messages for `inventory-sync`

## Summary
During the incident, `inventory-sync` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E2617 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `inventory-sync` fired.
- T+10: On-call engineer found PQ-E2617 in the broker logs.
- T+20: The team paused the noisiest producer.
- T+40: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E2617.
- Add an alert for this error code.

Document: d0406
Title: PaderQueue 3.0 release notes
Type: changelog
Version: 3.0

- **Changed default:** `metrics.interval_s` now defaults to `10` (previously `300`).
- **Changed default:** `scheduler.log_level` now defaults to `info` (previously `error`).

## New features

- New option `retention.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New option `ingress.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST starts throttling.
- New error code PQ-E1441 (COORDINATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4572 (QUOTA_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `broker.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues, in bytes.
- New option `metrics.log_level`: log verbosity of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New option `acktracker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.
- New option `quota.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.
- New error code PQ-E4007 (BROKER_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2154 (QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3891 (COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New error code PQ-E2758 (RETENTION_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2995 (QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1563

Title: PaderQueue 3.0 release notes
Type: changelog
Version: 3.0

- **Changed default:** `metrics.interval_s` now defaults to `10` (previously `300`).
- **Changed default:** `scheduler.log_level` now defaults to `info` (previously `error`).

## New features

- New option `retention.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New option `ingress.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST starts throttling.
- New error code PQ-E1441 (COORDINATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4572 (QUOTA_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `broker.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues, in bytes.
- New option `metrics.log_level`: log verbosity of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New option `acktracker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.
- New option `quota.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.
- New error code PQ-E4007 (BROKER_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2154 (QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3891 (COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New error code PQ-E2758 (RETENTION_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2995 (QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1563

# `pq token move`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Moves a token.

## Usage
```
pq token move <name> [flags]

|---|---|

| `--max-parallel` | Maximum number of nodes processed at the same time. Default: 2. |
| `--force` | Skip the confirmation prompt. |

pq token move orders --label
```

Title: Postmortem INC-2025-134
Type: incident
Version: 4.x

# Postmortem INC-2025-134: inventory-sync degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 25 minutes
**Impact:** Duplicate processing in `inventory-sync`

## Summary
During the incident, `inventory-sync` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4426 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `inventory-sync` fired.
- T+6: On-call engineer found PQ-E4426 in the broker logs.
- T+12: The team paused the noisiest producer.
- T+25: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4426.
- Add an alert for this error code.

Type: config
Version: 3.x

# `scheduler.batch_size` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Number of messages the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time processes together in one batch.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `100` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | scheduler |
| Unit | messages |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `scheduler.batch_size` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[scheduler]
batch_size = 100
```

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

- New option `spool.log_level`: log verbosity of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.

# Postmortem INC-2025-134: inventory-sync degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 25 minutes
**Impact:** Duplicate processing in `inventory-sync`

## Summary
During the incident, `inventory-sync` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4426 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `inventory-sync` fired.
- T+6: On-call engineer found PQ-E4426 in the broker logs.
- T+12: The team paused the noisiest producer.
- T+25: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4426.
- Add an alert for this error code.

- **Changed default:** `quota.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `33554432` (previously `4194304`).

- **Changed default:** `scheduler.log_level` now defaults to `info` (previously `error`).

## New features

- New option `retention.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client

Title: PQ-E1944 RETENTION_WORK_QUEUE_FULL
Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E1944 RETENTION_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `retention: work queue full`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 2.2

## What it means
The internal work queue of the retention is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `retention.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# PQ-E1799 RETENTION_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `retention: throttled`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.1

## What it means
The retention is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `retention.threshold_percent`.

# PQ-E2187 PARTITIONER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `partitioner: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the partitioner is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `partitioner.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

# `snapshotter.enabled`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Turns the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues on or off.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `true` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | snapshotter |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `snapshotter.enabled` only if you observe problems with the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
enabled = true
```

# PQ-E2995 QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The quota gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `quota.max_retries`.

Title: PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL
Type: error

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# PQ-E4157 REPLICATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the replicator is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `replicator.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

Title: pq snapshot create
Type: cli
Version: 4.x

# `pq snapshot create`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Creates a snapshot.

## Usage
```
pq snapshot create <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--timeout` | Seconds to wait for the operation to finish. Default: 30. |
| `--max-parallel` | Maximum number of nodes processed at the same time. Default: 2. |
| `--dry-run` | Show what would happen without changing anything. |
| `--force` | Skip the confirmation prompt. |

## Example
```
pq snapshot create orders --timeout
```

Document: d0001
Title: pq snapshot pause
Type: cli
Version: 4.x

# `pq snapshot pause`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Pauses a snapshot.

## Usage
```
pq snapshot pause <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--wait` | Block until the operation is completed on all nodes. |
| `--include-internal` | Also show internal system objects (names starting with `__`). |
| `--force` | Skip the confirmation prompt. |

## Example
```
pq snapshot pause orders --wait
```

Size of the in-memory buffer used by the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time, in bytes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (bytes) |
| Default | `4194304` |
| Available since | 2.3 |
| Component | scheduler |
| Unit | bytes |

## Notes

Changes to `scheduler.buffer_bytes` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[scheduler]
buffer_bytes = 4194304
```

# `pq node export`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Exports a node.

## Usage
```
pq node export <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--force` | Skip the confirmation prompt. |
| `--label` | Attach a `key=value` label. Can be repeated. |
| `--since` | Only consider objects created after this timestamp (ISO 8601). |

## Example
```
pq node export orders --force
```

Title: snapshotter.max_connections (PaderQueue 2.x)
Type: config
Version: 2.x

# `snapshotter.max_connections` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `256` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | snapshotter |
| Unit | connections |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `snapshotter.max_connections` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
max_connections = 256
```

Document: d0671
Title: snapshotter.max_connections
Type: config
Version: 4.x

# `snapshotter.max_connections`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `512` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | snapshotter |
| Unit | connections |
| Default changed | in 3.0 (see release notes) |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `snapshotter.max_connections` only if you observe problems with the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
max_connections = 512
```

Title: PaderQueue 3.0 release notes
Type: changelog
Version: 3.0

- **Changed default:** `metrics.interval_s` now defaults to `10` (previously `300`).
- **Changed default:** `scheduler.log_level` now defaults to `info` (previously `error`).

## New features

- New option `retention.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New option `ingress.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST starts throttling.
- New error code PQ-E1441 (COORDINATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4572 (QUOTA_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `broker.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues, in bytes.
- New option `metrics.log_level`: log verbosity of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New option `acktracker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.
- New option `quota.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.
- New error code PQ-E4007 (BROKER_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2154 (QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3891 (COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New error code PQ-E2758 (RETENTION_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2995 (QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1563

- New option `acktracker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

# `pq schedule create`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Creates a schedule.

## Usage
```
pq schedule create <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--tenant` | Name of the tenant the command applies to. |
| `--output` | Output format: `table`, `json` or `yaml`. Default: `table`. |
| `--dry-run` | Show what would happen without changing anything. |
| `--timeout` | Seconds to wait for the operation to finish. Default: 30. |

## Example
```
pq schedule create orders --tenant
```

pq schedule export <name> [flags]

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|

| `--retain-days` | Number of days the result is kept before it is deleted automatically. |
| `--timeout` | Seconds to wait for the operation to finish. Default: 30. |

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

- **Changed default:** `metrics.interval_s` now defaults to `10` (previously `300`).
- **Changed default:** `scheduler.log_level` now defaults to `info` (previously `error`).

## New features

- New option `retention.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New option `ingress.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST starts throttling.
- New error code PQ-E1441 (COORDINATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4572 (QUOTA_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `broker.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues, in bytes.
- New option `metrics.log_level`: log verbosity of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New option `acktracker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.
- New option `quota.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.
- New error code PQ-E4007 (BROKER_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2154 (QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3891 (COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New error code PQ-E2758 (RETENTION_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2995 (QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1563

# `replicator.worker_threads`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Number of worker threads used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `1` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | replicator |
| Unit | threads |
| Default changed | in 3.0 (see release notes) |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `replicator.worker_threads` only if you observe problems with the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[replicator]
worker_threads = 1
```

# Postmortem INC-2025-134: inventory-sync degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 25 minutes
**Impact:** Duplicate processing in `inventory-sync`

## Summary
During the incident, `inventory-sync` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4426 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `inventory-sync` fired.
- T+6: On-call engineer found PQ-E4426 in the broker logs.
- T+12: The team paused the noisiest producer.
- T+25: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4426.
- Add an alert for this error code.

Title: PaderQueue 3.0 release notes
Type: changelog

- **Changed default:** `metrics.interval_s` now defaults to `10` (previously `300`).
- **Changed default:** `scheduler.log_level` now defaults to `info` (previously `error`).

## New features

- New option `retention.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New option `ingress.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST starts throttling.
- New error code PQ-E1441 (COORDINATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4572 (QUOTA_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `broker.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues, in bytes.
- New option `metrics.log_level`: log verbosity of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New option `acktracker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.
- New option `quota.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.
- New error code PQ-E4007 (BROKER_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2154 (QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3891 (COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New error code PQ-E2758 (RETENTION_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2995 (QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1563

# PQ-E4030 AUTH_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `auth: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The auth refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `auth.max_connections`.

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `auth: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The auth gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `auth.max_retries`.

# PQ-E4030 AUTH_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `auth: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The auth refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `auth.max_connections`.

Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `auth.max_retries`.

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `coordinator: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The internal work queue of the coordinator is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `coordinator.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E4157 REPLICATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the replicator is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `replicator.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

# Postmortem INC-2025-134: inventory-sync degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 25 minutes
**Impact:** Duplicate processing in `inventory-sync`

## Summary
During the incident, `inventory-sync` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4426 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `inventory-sync` fired.
- T+6: On-call engineer found PQ-E4426 in the broker logs.
- T+12: The team paused the noisiest producer.
- T+25: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4426.
- Add an alert for this error code.

Title: coordinator.batch_size (PaderQueue 3.x)
Type: config
Version: 3.x

# `coordinator.batch_size` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Number of messages the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers processes together in one batch.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `500` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | coordinator |
| Unit | messages |

## Notes

Changes to `coordinator.batch_size` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[coordinator]
batch_size = 500
```

Document: d0121
Title: coordinator.queue_capacity (PaderQueue 3.x)
Type: config
Version: 3.x

# `coordinator.queue_capacity` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `5000` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | coordinator |
| Unit | tasks |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `coordinator.queue_capacity` only if you observe problems with the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[coordinator]
queue_capacity = 5000
```

```

# `coordinator.buffer_bytes` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Size of the in-memory buffer used by the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers, in bytes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (bytes) |
| Default | `4194304` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | coordinator |
| Unit | bytes |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `coordinator.buffer_bytes` only if you observe problems with the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[coordinator]
buffer_bytes = 4194304
```

# PQ-E2137 DLQ_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `dlq: throttled`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 1.2

## What it means
The dlq is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `dlq.threshold_percent`.

# PQ-E3246 SCHEDULER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The internal work queue of the scheduler is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `scheduler.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# PaderQueue 3.0 release notes

Released on 2023-09-18.

This is a major release. Read the section on changed defaults before upgrading.

## Changed defaults

- **Changed default:** `partitioner.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `16777216` (previously `1048576`).
- **Changed default:** `auth.interval_s` now defaults to `300` (previously `10`).
- **Changed default:** `retention.worker_threads` now defaults to `2` (previously `1`).
- **Changed default:** `metrics.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `4194304` (previously `1048576`).
- **Changed default:** `replicator.worker_threads` now defaults to `1` (previously `2`).
- **Changed default:** `spool.compression` now defaults to `lz4` (previously `zstd`).
- **Changed default:** `quota.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `33554432` (previously `4194304`).
- **Changed default:** `metrics.batch_size` now defaults to `256` (previously `32`).
- **Changed default:** `spool.threshold_percent` now defaults to `95` (previously `90`).
- **Changed default:** `retention.threshold_percent` now defaults to `95` (previously `90`).
- **Changed default:** `ingress.timeout_ms` now defaults to `500` (previously `2000`).
- **Changed default:** `quota.batch_size` now defaults to `256` (previously `500`).
- **Changed default:** `broker.compression` now defaults to `zstd` (previously `lz4`).
- **Changed default:** `compactor.compression` now defaults to `lz4` (previously `none`).
- **Changed default:** `spool.max_connections` now defaults to `1024` (previously `128`).
- **Changed default:** `retention.timeout_ms` now defaults to `2000` (previously `10000`).
- **Changed default:** `dlq.batch_size` now defaults to `256` (previously `100`).
- **Changed default:** `snapshotter.threshold_percent` now defaults to `80` (previously `75`).
- **Changed default:** `ingress.interval_s` now defaults to `5` (previously `300`).
- **Changed default:** `snapshotter.max_connections` now defaults to `512` (previously `256`).
- **Changed default:** `metrics.interval_s` now defaults to `10` (previously `300`).
- **Changed default:** `scheduler.log_level` now defaults to `info` (previously `error`).

## New features

- New option `retention.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client

# PaderQueue 3.0 release notes

Released on 2023-09-18.

This is a major release. Read the section on changed defaults before upgrading.

## Changed defaults

- **Changed default:** `partitioner.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `16777216` (previously `1048576`).
- **Changed default:** `auth.interval_s` now defaults to `300` (previously `10`).
- **Changed default:** `retention.worker_threads` now defaults to `2` (previously `1`).
- **Changed default:** `metrics.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `4194304` (previously `1048576`).
- **Changed default:** `replicator.worker_threads` now defaults to `1` (previously `2`).
- **Changed default:** `spool.compression` now defaults to `lz4` (previously `zstd`).
- **Changed default:** `quota.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `33554432` (previously `4194304`).
- **Changed default:** `metrics.batch_size` now defaults to `256` (previously `32`).
- **Changed default:** `spool.threshold_percent` now defaults to `95` (previously `90`).
- **Changed default:** `retention.threshold_percent` now defaults to `95` (previously `90`).
- **Changed default:** `ingress.timeout_ms` now defaults to `500` (previously `2000`).
- **Changed default:** `quota.batch_size` now defaults to `256` (previously `500`).
- **Changed default:** `broker.compression` now defaults to `zstd` (previously `lz4`).
- **Changed default:** `compactor.compression` now defaults to `lz4` (previously `none`).
- **Changed default:** `spool.max_connections` now defaults to `1024` (previously `128`).
- **Changed default:** `retention.timeout_ms` now defaults to `2000` (previously `10000`).
- **Changed default:** `dlq.batch_size` now defaults to `256` (previously `100`).
- **Changed default:** `snapshotter.threshold_percent` now defaults to `80` (previously `75`).
- **Changed default:** `ingress.interval_s` now defaults to `5` (previously `300`).
- **Changed default:** `snapshotter.max_connections` now defaults to `512` (previously `256`).
- **Changed default:** `metrics.interval_s` now defaults to `10` (previously `300`).
- **Changed default:** `scheduler.log_level` now defaults to `info` (previously `error`).

## New features

- New option `retention.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# PQ-E4157 REPLICATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the replicator is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `replicator.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

# PaderQueue 3.1 release notes

Released on 2024-01-15.

## New features

- New option `acktracker.batch_size`: number of messages the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed processes together in one batch.
- New error code PQ-E1176 (INGRESS_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `coordinator.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers.
- New option `spool.log_level`: log verbosity of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.
- New option `compactor.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.
- New option `broker.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues starts throttling.
- New option `coordinator.enabled`: turns the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers on or off.
- New option `compactor.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.
- New option `dlq.enabled`: turns the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue on or off.
- New option `compactor.batch_size`: number of messages the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages processes together in one batch.
- New error code PQ-E3249 (ACKTRACKER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `acktracker.enabled`: turns the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed on or off.
- New error code PQ-E3841 (REPLICATOR_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.

# PQ-E1783 AUTH_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `auth: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The auth gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `auth.max_retries`.

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

Title: PaderQueue 3.0 release notes
Type: changelog
Version: 3.0

- **Changed default:** `metrics.interval_s` now defaults to `10` (previously `300`).
- **Changed default:** `scheduler.log_level` now defaults to `info` (previously `error`).

## New features

- New option `retention.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New option `ingress.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST starts throttling.
- New error code PQ-E1441 (COORDINATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4572 (QUOTA_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `broker.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues, in bytes.
- New option `metrics.log_level`: log verbosity of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New option `acktracker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.
- New option `quota.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.
- New error code PQ-E4007 (BROKER_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2154 (QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3891 (COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New error code PQ-E2758 (RETENTION_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2995 (QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1563
